items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know what was going on and this was a thing I heard through Claude later, that by the time the Archie Winston article broke it was no longer a secret.

ctx.x: It was by that time no longer a secret. I had already been exposed. I didn't know what was going on and this was a thing I heard through Claude later, that by the time the Archie Winston article broke it was no longer a secret.
This overnight success which led you to Hollywood which we'll come to in a little while, was that a hard thing for you to go through? Apparently it was a big change in your life.
